verdict.rationale: Databricks documents a pay-as-you-go pricing model with no up-front costs and per-second billing granularity, and one user reports simply scaling up and updating their opex estimate, so the pricing structure is at least described. However, a hands-on PoC report says the quoted license cost excluded the underlying EC2 costs, making the real bill at least double, which shows the documented model alone can mislead estimates. Budgets are after-the-fact spend tracking, not pre-commitment estimation, so they earn no credit here. missing for 10: documented per-unit (DBU) rates by product/tier, a pricing calculator or worked estimation guidance, clear disclosure of separate cloud-infrastructure costs, independent confirmation that bills can be estimated accurately up front
